items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Richard Rodgers and Lorenz Hart, I preferred the early Rodgers by far to the later Rodgers.

ctx.x: Favorite songwriters, my God, you know the old phrase, “We stand on the shoulders of giants,” there are so many giants and I’m fortunate enough to be on the board of governors of ASCAP, I have been for the past six years and you run into these giants, or their ghosts up their because it was founded, one of the founders was Irving Berlin who was really American music basically and has been for the last you know forty, fifty years. Oh God, Berlin, Jerome Kern, Richard Rodgers and Lorenz Hart, I preferred the early…
